environment.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Laptop GPU, 8188 MiB, compute 8.9, driver 595.91.07
environment.shared_machine: other agents active, load average 8 to 16 on 16 threads

benchmark.statistic: median of three runs of each p50

base_versus_optimized.note: base and optimized runs interleaved, CPU at load 15-16 and CUDA at load 8, metrics in microseconds except *_s (seconds) and rss_mib

cpu_versus_cuda.note: optimized build, CPU and CUDA runs interleaved at load 13-14

cuda_calls_per_ppo_tick.method: nsys --trace=cuda, difference between 192 and 64 measured ticks divided by 128, US tapes

concurrency.method: K processes of the optimized benchmark on US tapes with --repeat (12 on CUDA, 20 on CPU), first repetition discarded, aggregate = sum of per-process rates, MPS with a private pipe directory

memory.mars_titan_sim_note: ru_maxrss from wait4 keeps the pre-exec peak of the parent image, VmHWM counts only the executed image

trace_parity_note: mars-titan-sim --trace on the validation tapes, base versus optimized build, JSON identical except identity_sha256

assumptions: CPU PPO tick uses the first step of a new trainer, without bootstrap reuse, because CPU only admits the 32-transition diagnostic
Double DQN tick = first step - PPO act + Double DQN act on both devices, on CUDA the first step is 1.6 times the steady step
reference steps use the single-lane evaluation step, an upper bound
parallel hours divide by the aggregate speedup measured on KLPO collection (CPU) or the smaller of trainer and KLPO speedups (MPS)

survived: collector computes the validated count after appending the step

checks.pytest: 168 passed with this build, including 6 real-edition smoke tests
